main_subject.description: An adult woman with long dark middle-parted hair, soft pink makeup, and a pensive direct gaze.
main_subject.wardrobe: A cream crew-neck short-sleeve T-shirt with a tiny abstract embroidery, high-waisted full-length medium-wash jeans, white crew socks, and closed-toe dark slip-on shoes.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Seated comfortably on the kitchen floor beside an open retro refrigerator, holding an unbranded red sparkling-water can at chest level.

composition_elements.setting: Warm vintage kitchen or studio with an open cream refrigerator containing plain-label colorful soft drinks, a blank pastel food magazine, and two unlabeled bottles on the floor.
composition_elements.framing: Eye-level full-body portrait with the refrigerator interior framing the subject.
composition_elements.text_and_brand_control: No beverage brands, logos, product labels, magazine title, or readable copy.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Warm muted refrigerator and room light.

technical_specs.rendering: Fine grain, natural skin, realistic hands, subdued retro palette, no glossy product-ad appearance.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical soft 35mm lifestyle film portrait of an adult woman with long dark middle-parted hair, soft pink makeup, and a pensive direct gaze. She wears a cream crew-neck short-sleeve T-shirt with tiny abstract embroidery, high-waisted full-length medium-wash jeans, white crew socks, and closed-toe dark slip-on shoes. She sits comfortably on a warm vintage kitchen floor beside an open cream retro refrigerator, holding an unbranded red sparkling-water can at chest level. Fill the fridge with plain-label colorful soft drinks and a blank pastel food magazine; place two unlabeled bottles on the floor. Use eye-level full-body framing, fine grain, natural skin and hands, muted warmth, and no glossy advertising appearance. No beverage brand, logo, readable label, magazine title, text, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, lingerie, fetish styling, distressed shorts, open-toe footwear, brand name, logo, readable label, text, watermark, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, plastic skin, AI artifacts
